payload.text: First real runs of the one-command release: pplr's next release and Cldr's next (Cldr f382994, pushed; its CI run on build.yml was queued at the push, so check it is green). Cldr's first signed release moves its tap from source to assets; the tap clone at ../Brew/homebrew-cldr may need a pull. Lamplight moves to Geodica/Certificates' APPLE_APP_PASSWORD, then its own is revoked.
